chapter: Becoming a musician: ukulele, clarinet and the Boozaire Kings
title: Chris Kelly playing for the Pecan Grove dance
summary: Kids watched from the fence as Chris Kelly played low-down blues for dark working people dancing in the Pecan Grove yard.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: And then they have a party in the Pecan Grove, and you go in there and you get on a fence and look down at... Pecan Grove is a yard that had a large pecan tree in it, and the people from the lower coast, the people that work hard... And they was all dark people, you see, because in New Orleans you get them different color strata, you see. But these were all dark people, and they all look alike, and they're all dancing, and they're having fun. And Chris Kelly is playing for them, and he'd playing them low-down Blues, and you can hear it from the neighborhood, and you'd get up on the fence and you'd look down there. And you'd see Mister So-and-So is (?) dancing with Miss Lucy, and

you'd see them in the corner, and they'd be grinding and belly-rubbing, and you'd see that, and next thing you know, they're (?) and drinkin' and they're signifyin'. And you'd see that, and you'd say, "Yeah, Mister Chris Kelly, the greatest... Mister Chris Kelly, will you have a drink? You boys want some sandwiches?"
